evals.name: bootstrap-freemius
evals.prompt: Integrate Freemius into my plugin with a free plan and a Pro plan.
evals.expected_output: Copy freemius/start.php via SDK. Add fs_dynamic_init() with plugin_id, slug, public_key, is_premium=true, has_paid_plans=true, is_org_compliant=true, anonymous_mode_enabled=true. Single my_plugin_fs() singleton getter. Call on plugins_loaded. Add menu with pricing=true. Define plan configs.

evals.name: gate-premium-feature
evals.prompt: Gate the export feature so only Pro license holders can use it.
evals.expected_output: Wrap export code with if(my_plugin_fs()->can_use_premium_code()). AJAX handler: check nonce, then premium check, return wp_send_json_error with upgrade_url if free. Admin UI: show upgrade CTA with get_upgrade_url() link when free. Free version must still be functional (not wp_die'd). WP.org compliant.

evals.name: wporg-compliance-fix
evals.prompt: The WP.org review team rejected my Freemius plugin for trialware — fix it.
evals.expected_output: Set is_org_compliant=>true and anonymous_mode_enabled=>true in fs_dynamic_init(). Remove any wp_die/exit on free-tier access. Ensure plugin is fully functional without license. Make upgrade notices dismissible. No full-page upsell on activation. Free tier must have real value, not just a nag screen.
